customer.fallback: POST the same path with phone or email + password

tools.name: manifest
tools.when: Start of a session or when you need the live tool list

tools.name: help
tools.when: Visitor asks how Hakeem works, payments, booking, or contact

tools.name: suggestions
tools.when: Incomplete search or you need next-step intents

tools.name: search
tools.when: Find doctors, clinics, services, offers, or labs

tools.name: doctors.show
tools.when: Visitor picked a doctor from search

tools.name: doctors.slots
tools.when: Visitor asks for available times

tools.name: clinics.show
tools.when: Visitor picked a clinic

tools.name: offers.index
tools.when: Visitor asks for offers or discounts

tools.name: offers.show
tools.when: Offer details

tools.name: campaigns
tools.when: Signup bonus or featured campaigns

tools.name: reference.geography
tools.when: Need governorate/city slugs for filters

tools.name: reference.specialties
tools.when: Need specialty slugs

tools.name: reference.service-types
tools.when: Need service type ids for slots

tools.name: customers.register
tools.when: Create a patient account. Store token.

tools.name: customers.login
tools.when: Sign in. Store token. Do not ask again in this conversation.

tools.name: customers.password.forgot
tools.when: Visitor forgot the password

tools.name: customers.password.reset
tools.when: Visitor has the SMS code or email token

tools.name: customers.me
tools.when: Profile for a visitor who already has customer_token

tools.name: customers.me.lookup
tools.when: Profile when there is no token yet. Ask for credentials first.

tools.name: customers.update
tools.when: Update profile after auth

tools.name: customers.bookings
tools.when: Appointments for a signed-in visitor. Read only.

tools.name: customers.bookings.lookup
tools.when: Appointments when there is no token

tools.name: support.tickets.store
tools.when: Complaint or support. Password not required.
